Compute Per-Match Venue Factor

Source: R/elo_calibration.R
compute_venue_factor.Rd

Returns a numeric vector (+1 / 0 / -1) matching the length of home_team/away_team. See file header for the convention.

Usage

compute_venue_factor(home_team, away_team, league, season)

Arguments

home_team, away_team, league, season

Vectors of equal length.

Value

Numeric vector of -1 / 0 / +1.

Details

Domestic leagues + UCL/UEL/UECL: always +1 (home team at home). Qualifiers (WCQ_* / EUROQ / AFCONQ / ACUPQ) + Nations League: +1 (these are scheduled home/away at real stadiums). Intl_Friendlies: default +1 (we don't know venue; friendlies are usually at the home_team's stadium but can be neutral). Tournament matches: parse host from season; +1 if home_team is host, -1 if away_team is host, 0 if neither.
